`refactor(identity): update sportmatch theme and restructure realm configuration`

feat(profile-service): add Kafka integration, REST APIs, and docker-compose setup
- Introduced Kafka support (producers, consumers, and configuration) in `profile-service`. - Added REST APIs for CRUD operations and profile search with pagination. - Implemented health checks for PostgreSQL, Keycloak, Kafka, and Kafka UI. - Introduced `ProfileUpdateRequest` DTO and updated request handling with validation. - Updated `docker-compose.yml` to set up PostgreSQL, Keycloak, Kafka, and Kafka UI. - Refactored error handling and mapper logic to support new features.
